image_description: A close-up shot of a white, textured waffle cone held by a hand (partially visible at the bottom). The cone contains three distinct scoops of ice cream: a yellow/green base scoop (possibly pistachio or lemon), a middle dark brown scoop (chocolate) with small spherical inclusions, and a top pale green/white scoop that appears slightly melted and draped. There are also small grey/blue spherical toppings scattered on the chocolate scoop.
